missed.why: No confidentiality clause, but a security line about "Supplier personnel" was taken as a possible passage.
No assistance with Articles 32 to 36, but the breach notice clause was taken as a possible passage.
A building fire-safety "inspection" was taken as a possible audit clause.
Two documents give different notice periods for new sub-processors; not flagged as a conflict.
"Where is customer data hosted?": the right passage was not in the top 5.
"What information will a breach notification contain?": the right passage was not in the top 5.
"Do you operate a 24/7 security operations centre?": the right passage was not in the top 5.
"thirty (30) calendar days" is not read as a number, so 90 days vs 30 days was not compared.
The answer leaves out a listed sub-processor; only extra names are checked, not missing ones.
"hosted and supported from within the European Union" is not recognised as an EU-only claim.
Backups "14 days" vs "six (6) months": the DPA sentence shares too few words with the question to be compared.
"Audits through our SOC 2 report" agrees with the DPA, but was flagged as partly found.
